01112 Bel'shatstsar {be:l-shats-tsar'}

源自外來語 (與 01095 比較); 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Belshazzar 1; 1

伯沙撒 = "彼勒保護國王"
1) 巴比倫的末代國王; 先知但以理就是向他解明出現在牆上的字 (#但 8:1|)

of foreign origin (compare 01095);; n pr m

Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"
1) king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel
   interpreted the writing on the wall
